_comment: Copy to december/config.local.json (git-ignored) and edit. Every key is optional; an environment variable DEC_<NAME> (DEC_INBOX, DEC_GUIDE, DEC_FILM_MASTER, DEC_WHISPER_EXE, DEC_WHISPER_MODEL, DEC_RNNOISE, DEC_PYTHON, DEC_FACE_MODEL) wins over this file. Use forward slashes, also on Windows.
